name: Wenona
source:
As one of the youngest billionaires in the country, Wenona redefines what it means to be a ruthless business woman. The Ultimate Entrepreneur rules over the agriculture sector, owning over 90% of the farmland and naturally growing produce. Rarely does the public get to see this elusive CEO, but when they do, they quickly realize how cold and determined she can be, only willing to discuss the potential profits and projections of her operations in the upcoming financial quarter.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1352041760009166849]official source[/url]]
